name: MedFM-Robust
description: Medical foundation models have achieved remarkable clinical performance, yet their robustness under real-world perturbations remains underexplored. We present a robustness benchmark comprising 40 perturbation types (12 base, 28 medical-specific) across eight imaging modalities, evaluating five VLMs (LLaVA-Med, MedGemma, MedGemma-1.5, Gemini-2.5-flash and GPT-4o-mini) on VQA, visual grounding, and captioning, alongside two segmentation models (MedSAM, SAM-Med2D) with five fine-tuning strategies.
